abstract: A follow-up study of 224 male patients from Rochester, Minnesota, diagnosed with cryptorchidism during the period from 1935 through 1974 was conducted to assess the frequency of subsequent testicular neoplasms. Age-specific rates for testicular neoplasm in this community were used to estimate an expected number for comparison with that observed. Two malignant testicular neoplasms have occurred in this cohort; thus, the standardized morbidity ratio was 11.4 (95% confidence interval, 1.4 to 41.1). Of the 158 patients born in the community, 11% were known to have birth weights of less than 2,500 g, approximately twice the expected occurrence. Increased risks were also noted for inguinal hernia, hypospadias, Down's syndrome, cleft lip or palate (or both), clubfoot, and congenital heart disease, for which the standardized morbidity ratios were 3.6, 4.7, 17.8, 11.3, 11.7, and 2.7, respectively. The increased risk for malignant neoplasms observed in this cohort of patients with cryptorchidism is consistent with that found in earlier studies.
abstract_ja: ミネソタ州ロチェスターで1935年から1974年の間に停留精巣と診断された男性224例を対象に、その後の精巣腫瘍の発生を評価するフォローアップ研究を行った。年齢別の地域発生率を用いて期待値を算出し、観察数と比較した。精巣腫瘍は2例の悪性腫瘍が発生し、標準化罹患比は11.4（95%信頼区間 1.4〜41.1）であった。このコホートでは、出生時体重2,500g未満の割合が地域の予想値の約2倍であった。また、鼠径ヘルニア（標準化罹患比3.6）、尿道下裂（4.7）、ダウン症候群（17.8）、口唇裂・口蓋裂（11.3）、先天性内反足（11.7）、先天性心疾患（2.7）についても、リスクの上昇が認められた。停留精巣患者における悪性腫瘍リスクの増加は、これまでの研究と一致している。
